title: Degree-zero Cech normalization agrees with inverse-image Ext action
statement: For a scheme morphism g : Y → X [def-pc-scheme] and covers U,V with each V-tuple intersection contained in the preimage of its U-tuple intersection, the degree-zero homology map of the explicit unit cochain map [def-pc-cech-inverse-image-cochain-map], conjugated by the Cech global-section isomorphisms and H⁰ global-section isomorphisms, equals the exact inverse-image Ext action using constIso(g).symm [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. This statement contains no comparison system or positive degree.

source.place: Lemma 20.15.1 and Tag 01EQ; assigned unit-comparison node proof, degree-zero section faces

proof.text: For any coefficient map alpha : F -> g_*G, prove naturality of the degree-zero restriction augmentation. On a one-tuple the cochain map is alpha followed by restriction; naturality of alpha and composition of restrictions identify it with restricting the pulled-back global section. Pass to homology using homology-pi naturality and the liftCycles identities. This is the private proved helper cech_augmentation_naturality, using the existing toCechCohomologyZero of WeilConjectures.Topology.Sheaves.CechCohomology.

Identify the adjunct of constIso(g).inv followed by inverse image of a morphism f out of the constant integer sheaf. Unfold constIso as uniqueness of left adjoints, apply homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to the reversed comparison, then expand the composed adjunction and use unit naturality. This gives the global-sections adjunct of f followed by the inverse-image unit. Write every Ext-zero class as mk-zero of f, use mapExactFunctor_mk-zero and mk-zero composition, and evaluate the constant-sheaf adjunct via uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv. These are the private proved helpers constant_adjunct_pullback and ext_zero_sections. The restriction from the preimage of top to top is the identity by map_id.

Use the existing cechCohomologyZeroIso to express the input as the restriction class of a global section s. Step 1 identifies its cochain-map image with the restriction class of the unit-pulled-back section t. Cancel the two Cech isomorphisms, apply the injective Ext-to-sections equivalence, and use Step 2 to obtain the stated equality. Both cover hypotheses are used only through their zero isomorphisms; no nonempty index set or nonempty scheme is assumed, so empty covers and empty schemes are included.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 20.15.1, degree-zero face; Tag 01EQ, restriction augmentation. Formalized directly by V4 using existing Cech zero isomorphisms, exact-functor Ext zero identities, and uniqueness of left adjoints.

theorem cechInverseImage_degree_zero
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hcover' : iSup V = ⊤)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (x : (TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyFunctor U 0).obj F) :
    (((TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyZeroIso V hcover').inv ≫
        (Sheaf.functorHZeroIso.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) isTerminalTop).inv).app
        ((invImage g).obj F))
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        (cechInverseImageCochainMap g U V hinter F ((invImage g).obj F)
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u} g.base).unit.app
            F).hom) 0 x) =
      Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm F 0
        ((((TopCat.Sheaf.cechCohomologyZeroIso U hcover).inv ≫
          (Sheaf.functorHZeroIso.{u} (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) isTerminalTop).inv).app F)
          x)
